ipa.surfaces.cap.CapSurfaceDefinition

The definition of the volatility surface.

Available as lseg.data.content.ipa.surfaces.cap.CapSurfaceDefinition.

Syntax

IIrVolModelDefinition(
    *,
    instrument_code: OptStr = None,
    discounting_type: DiscountingType | None = None,
    index_name: OptStr = None,
    reference_caplet_tenor: OptStr = None,
)

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
instrument_code OptStr No None The currency of the interest rate volatility model.
discounting_type DiscountingType | None No None The discounting type of the interest rate volatility model. the default value is selected based on 'instrumentcode'.
index_name OptStr No None Underlying index name.
reference_caplet_tenor OptStr No None Reference caplet payment or index tenor. ex: 1m, 3m, 6m, 1y.

Related types

DiscountingType

Name Value Description
DiscountingType.LIBOR_DISCOUNTING 'LiborDiscounting'
DiscountingType.OIS_DISCOUNTING 'OisDiscounting'
